description: This file defines the 'Controller' class, which extends 'SugarBean' and manages component ordering, wall boundary checks, and deletion adjustments within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM framework. It includes methods for changing component order, updating affected components, checking walls, and deleting with order adjustments.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: A class managing component positioning and boundary checks within a CRM module, extending SugarBean.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Controller object and disabling row-level security.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the focus object and type for the controller.

methods.name: change_component_order
methods.description: Changes the order of components, adjusting positions based on direction and handling wall boundaries.

methods.name: update_affected_order
methods.description: Updates the position of an affected component in the database.

methods.name: get_affected_id
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the component affected by a position change.

methods.name: check_wall
methods.description: Checks if a movement exceeds the boundary limits (walls) based on the component's positioning.

methods.name: delete_adjust_order
methods.description: Adjusts ordering of components after deletion along the specified axis.
